points.case_title: Information is provided about security practices
points.quote_text:
How do we protect your information?

We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information when you enter, submit, or access your personal information. Among other things, your browser session, as well as the traffic between your applications and the API, are secured with SSL, and your password is hashed using a strong one-way algorithm.
points.title: The user is informed about security practices

points.case_title: Your account can be deleted or permanently suspended without prior notice and without a reason
points.quote_text: These provisions notwithstanding, the administration of the service reserves the right to revoke any user's access permissions, at any time, for any reason, except as limited by law.
points.title: The service can delete your account without prior notice

points.case_title: This service is only available to users over a certain age
points.quote_text:
Our site, products and services are all directed to people who are at least 16 years old.
If you are under the age of 16, per the requirements of the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) do not use this site.</
points.title: This service is only available to users of a certain age

points.case_title: Two factor authentication is provided for your account
points.quote_text: You may enable two-factor authentication to further secure access to your account.</

  • Retain server logs containing the IP address of all requests to this server, in so far as such logs are kept, no more than 90 days.</
